verdict.rationale: Capacities does expose a documented REST API for accessing/creating/manipulating content and an MCP integration path, but the docs only describe generic CRUD capability, not parity with UI features like AI assistant, templates, graph view, backlinks, or exports; no OpenAPI spec was found (404s) to confirm full endpoint coverage. missing for 10: evidence that AI features, templates, graph/backlinks, and export/import workflows are all API-accessible, and a published API reference confirming full UI parity.
